messages:
Jordan (AM): Heads-up — Acme Health is green to start a POC but they have tight geo constraints. They need EU + Mexico-only data paths for inference and embeddings. Main asks: 1) Can we guarantee routing so data never leaves EU or Mexico for their tenant? 2) BYOK in EU and Mexico? 3) Which subprocessors touch traffic in those regions? 4) Any pricing delta for geo-pin / egress isolation?

Mira (SE): Quick answers up-front: we support geo-pin for Dedicated and Private deployments. Hosted API does NOT currently offer per-tenant Mexico region pinning (we have eu-* and us/*, some latam via us regions). BYOK is available for Dedicated & Private; hosted BYOK is limited. I need to check subprocessors for Mexico specifically — will loop in Alex.

Alex S (Security): Re: subprocessors — for hosted, primary subprocessors by region are AWS (eu-west-1, eu-central-1), GCP (europe-west*), and a CDN provider that may have edge POPs in LATAM (we need to confirm exact peering). Mexico-specific subprocessors: we rely on our cloud provider's local POPs but we do NOT currently run a managed cluster inside MX datacenters. That means if the customer requires physical data residency strictly inside Mexican sovereign borders we likely need Private on-prem or a VPC hosting partner we can provision in MX (we've done this as an exception).

Priya (Solutions): To summarize options for Acme Health: 
- Hosted API: fastest, but cannot promise MX-only residency.
- Dedicated (reserved capacity in EU + pin to us-central as fallback): can get closer but MX-only still uncertain.
- Private / on-prem: yes, we can certify data never leaves chosen sites; requires lead time, SOW and infra.

Mira (SE): For the POC we can propose a hybrid test: embed requests originating from MX using a regional edge (edge->eu routing) and show controls. For real residency requirement we should scope Private deployment.

Jordan (AM): Customer is asking for an explicit subprocessor inventory and a short note we can give legal (one page). Also they want a delta on pricing for: geo-pin (per-month), BYOK setup/rotation, and a high-level estimate for Private deployment provisioning. Can someone draft the one-pager and a back-of-envelope price band?

Alex S (Security): I'll draft a one-pager list of subprocessors + routing guarantees and add the controls (KMS BYOK support, audit logs, retention). Note: for hosted we can state "geographic affinity" but not absolute MX-only guarantees.

Mira (SE): Pricing quick notes: geo-pin addon for Dedicated ~ +15-25% on base monthly commit (depends on capacity and standby), BYOK setup fee (one-time) ~ $8k-$15k depending on KMS integration and HSM requirements, Private on-prem starts at ~ $120k setup + recurring infra fees. I'll convert to ranges and attach to the POC quote.

presales-bot: New presales ticket created: PS-2025-119 — Acme Health geo-residency POC. Assignees: Mira (SE), Alex S (Security).

Jordan (AM): Thanks. Next steps: Alex — one-pager for legal by EOD tomorrow; Mira — include geo-pin pricing ranges in the POC quote and note fallback behaviors; Priya — please set up a call with customer (they want network/CIDR + latency SLO discussion).

Priya (Solutions): On it. I'll grab a 30m slot for Thursday and ask them to share expected RPS, sample prompts, and if they need embeddings persisted. Also request whether they require customer-managed KMS keys in EU/MX.

Alex S (Security): Draft will include a suggested wording for "routing policy" that we can tee into the contract: `We will make commercially reasonable efforts to route and process Customer Data within selected regions. Where Provider-controlled edge or provider limitations make strict country-only residency infeasible, Provider will document fallback paths and provide audit logs.`

Jordan (AM): Perfect. Please drop the one-pager and quote link into this thread when ready. :thumbsup:
